title: exp.evidence/1
description: Evidence bundle piece posted by the runner to the collector (POST speedtests/{id}/evidence, 12 sections 5.2/7.2): one document per kind. Bounded: at most 256 KiB serialized per test across all kinds (enforced by the collector), top-50 flows, at most 200 log lines. Field names come ONLY from the vendor references named in each description (Mist OAS 3.1 in the mistapi 0.64.1 SDK, MIT; HPE pyedgeconnect 0.16.0a1, MIT); HPE Aruba SSE has no local vendor documentation, so there is no SSE connector (CR-m6-spec-resolutions). additionalProperties is false everywhere: nothing outside these fields (e.g. Mist guest name/email) can be stored.

ap_mac.description: stats_wireless_client.ap_mac (AP the client is connected to).

proto.description: stats_wireless_client.proto (802.11 amendment, enum copied from the OAS).

idle_time_s.description: stats_wireless_client.idle_time (seconds since the last RX packet)

retry_pct.description: DERIVED by the runner: (tx_retries / tx_pkts) * 100. Not a Mist field.

client.description: Client stats at test time. Source: Mist OpenAPI 3.1 (mistapi 0.64.1 mist_openapi/mist.openapi.json), schema stats_wireless_client (operationId getSiteWirelessClientStats / listSiteWirelessClientsStats). Deliberately omits the Mist guest object (it carries name/email) and username/psk fields: identity evidence carries the allowed ones.

ap_name.description: stats_ap.name (AP display name; renamed so no evidence object has a bare person-like key)

band.description: Which stats_ap.radio_stat key the client's radio is: band_24 / band_5 / band_6.

ap.description: AP the client was on: stats_ap (operationId listSiteDevicesStats type=ap) incl. radio_stat. Mist OpenAPI 3.1 (mistapi 0.64.1 mist_openapi/mist.openapi.json)

roams.description: Roams of this client in the window: GET /sites/{site_id}/events/fast_roam, operationId listSiteRoamingEvents, schema event_fastroam. Mist OpenAPI 3.1 (mistapi 0.64.1 mist_openapi/mist.openapi.json)

type_code.description: events_client.type_code (reason code of association / disassociation events)

roam_count.description: DERIVED by the runner: number of roams with type != none in the window.

auth_failures.description: DERIVED by the runner: events classified as authentication failures (classification from Mist's runtime event constants).

data_wifi.description: kind=wifi (Mist wireless). Every key is optional (a status partial/unavailable evidence carries what was obtainable). Mist OpenAPI 3.1 (mistapi 0.64.1 mist_openapi/mist.openapi.json)
